newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Meo named head of TVNZ board.
newsitem.headline: Meo named head of TVNZ board.

text.p: AMP chairwoman Roseanne Meo was named by the government on Monday as the new chairman of Television New Zealand's board.
Meo replaces Norman Geary, who retired last year.
Meo, a former Employers' Federation President, is the former chairwoman of Forestry Corporation and is a director of Mercury Energy and Ports of Auckland.
TVNZ Group Chief Executive Chris Anderson said: "Mrs Meo has an outstanding background in business and community service which will be invaluable in addressing the major issues facing the company."
